tools.title: Temp Cleaner
tools.desc: Deletes eligible temporary files from Windows and user temp folders. Some files may be in use.

tools.title: Disk Space Check
tools.desc: Displays used and free space on available drives.

tools.title: Update Cache Cleaner
tools.desc: Clears selected Windows Update download cache files. Windows may need to download updates again.

tools.title: DNS Flush
tools.desc: Clears cached DNS lookups to troubleshoot certain website connection problems.

tools.title: Recycle Bin Cleaner
tools.desc: Empties the Recycle Bin after confirmation. Contents are permanently removed.

tools.title: Windows Component Cleanup
tools.desc: Uses DISM to clean up superseded Windows components where supported.

tools.title: System File Repair
tools.desc: Runs SFC to scan and repair protected Windows system files.

tools.title: DISM Image Repair
tools.desc: Uses DISM to repair the Windows component image.

tools.title: Disk Error Check
tools.desc: Runs an online file system scan to check for disk errors.

tools.title: Network Reset
tools.desc: Resets selected networking components to troubleshoot connection problems.

tools.title: IP Refresh
tools.desc: Releases and renews an IP address where supported by the network configuration.

tools.title: Winsock Repair
tools.desc: Resets the Winsock catalog to help resolve some network errors.

tools.title: Windows Update Troubleshooter
tools.desc: Opens built in Windows troubleshooting or update settings.

tools.title: Audio Service Restart
tools.desc: Restarts relevant Windows audio services when possible.

tools.title: Print Spooler Fix
tools.desc: Restarts the print spooler to resolve certain stuck print jobs.

tools.title: Thumbnail Cache Reset
tools.desc: Rebuilds thumbnail caches when File Explorer previews are missing or incorrect.

tools.title: Icon Cache Reset
tools.desc: Rebuilds the icon cache when desktop or File Explorer icons appear incorrect.

tools.title: File Explorer Restart
tools.desc: Restarts Windows Explorer if the taskbar or desktop becomes unresponsive.

tools.title: DNS And Network Fix
tools.desc: Combines DNS flushing with selected network diagnostics.

tools.title: Windows Activation Status
tools.desc: Displays Windows activation and licensing status.

tools.title: Startup Apps Report
tools.desc: Lists common startup locations and entries for review.

tools.title: Running Processes
tools.desc: Displays running processes and available process information.

tools.title: Battery Report
tools.desc: Generates a battery health and usage report on supported laptops.

tools.title: WiFi Report
tools.desc: Shows wireless interface status and saved Wi Fi profile names without exposing passwords.

tools.title: System Information
tools.desc: Displays Windows version, hardware and system information.

tools.title: Driver Information
tools.desc: Generates a report of installed drivers.

tools.title: Large Files Search
tools.desc: Helps locate large files for manual review instead of deleting them automatically.

tools.title: Memory Diagnostic
tools.desc: Offers to launch Windows Memory Diagnostic. A restart may be required.

tools.title: Power Efficiency Report
tools.desc: Generates a power efficiency report where supported.

tools.title: Event Log Viewer
tools.desc: Opens Event Viewer to investigate system errors and warnings.

tools.title: Windows Temp Cleaner
tools.desc: Cleans eligible files in Windows temporary directories.

tools.title: User Temp Cleaner
tools.desc: Cleans eligible temporary files for the current user.

tools.title: Delivery Optimization Cleaner
tools.desc: Guides the user to Windows cleanup options for the update delivery cache.

tools.title: Component Store Analysis
tools.desc: Reports Windows component store cleanup information using DISM.

tools.title: Storage Sense Settings
tools.desc: Opens Storage Sense settings for automatic cleanup.

tools.title: Hibernation Control
tools.desc: Offers a choice to disable hibernation and reclaim space. This affects hibernation and may affect Fast Startup.

tools.title: Optimize Drive
tools.desc: Opens the Windows drive optimization tool.

tools.title: Clipboard Reset
tools.desc: Clears clipboard contents after confirmation.

tools.title: System Restore Settings
tools.desc: Opens System Protection settings to review restore points.

tools.title: Maintenance Menu
tools.desc: Provides a menu to launch selected maintenance scripts.
